system.description: Terror 3, Frenzy, Reach, Four Arms, Sensitive Nostrils Bloodgreed: kills an opponent, it may perform a manoeuvre to feast on the flesh. If it does, it recovers 1 normal wound and gains 1 {Dc}. If not, it loses 1 Aggression. Bloodlust: A ghorgon inflicts +2 damage against the ally wounded.
